instruction.text: Match the singular noun to its plural form.
Match the singular noun to its plural form.
Write the plural form of the underlined word.

atoms.a: On Sunday afternoons, the <u>goose</u> like to swim in the canal.
atoms.b: On Sunday afternoons, the ((geese)) like to swim in the canal.

atoms.a: When the new hospital opens, it could save many <u>life</u>.
atoms.b: When the new hospital opens, it could save many ((lives)).

atoms.a: Arun got not one but two <u>puppy</u> for Christmas.
atoms.b: Arun got not one but two ((puppies)) for Christmas.

atoms.a: In autumn, all the <u>leaf</u> on the trees change colour.
atoms.b: In autumn, all the ((leaves)) on the trees change colour.

atoms.a: Grandad made a pie out of <u>potato</u> for dinner.
atoms.b: Grandad made a pie out of ((potatoes)) for dinner.

atoms.a: The <u>flash</u> of light from the fireworks scared the dog.
atoms.b: The ((flashes)) of light from the fireworks scared the dog.
